📖 How to use

  1. Enter the invoice amount, due date and monthly penalty rate.
  2. Set the as-of date (defaults to today).
  3. Read days late, the fee and the total due.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the late fee calculated?

Days late = as-of date − due date (0 if not yet due). Fee = invoice × monthly rate × days ÷ 30.

Is the fee simple or compounding?

Simple pro-rated monthly fee here. If your contract compounds monthly, compute month by month instead.

What date should I use as "as of"?

Set the as-of date to the payment date to see exactly what was owed when the invoice was settled.
